messages:
tomas: Quick sync — private endpoint controlplane handshake telemetry + authz backoff. Noticing bursts during onboarding causing intermittent 504s. Anyone else seeing this?

sara: yep, saw spike this morning during the bulk-onboard job. many parallel attach attempts. tokens are failing validation at CP side.

michael: i think it's a combo of cert rotation jitter + agents retrying with no jitter. they hammer the /handshake endpoint and we start queuing.

jen: proposal: add jittered exponential backoff in agent bootstrap + a short-lived local cache for successful attach tokens (per-tenant, TTL ~10s). also emit metrics: attach_attempts, attach_errors, attach_backoff_seconds.

tomas: +1 for backoff. worried about token caching and immediate revokes — we should honor revoke webhooks to flush cache.

carmen: ops constraint: if we cache, we must be able to invalidate on key rotation. that means a small pub/sub invalidate channel or CP push event.

infra-bot: FYI — current handshake contract: POST /handshake 
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
         X-Tenant-ID: <tenant-id>
Body: { agent_id, version }

michael: on authz mode: OIDC short-lived tokens are simpler but rely on CP introspection often. mTLS reduces CP load but increases cert rotation complexity for customers. tradeoffs?

jen: for private endpoints my vote is mTLS for strong network identity, but provide an OIDC fallback for lightweight edge agents. document both.

sara: telemetry: we should sample 1% full traces but 100% of attach counters and error logs aggregated per-tenant. also add histogram buckets for handshake latency [50,100,250,500,1000,5000]ms.

michael: fallback policy: if attach fails after N backoff attempts, route that customer's traffic to regional-relay (best-effort) and mark the endpoint degraded in console. must be opt-out for high-security tenants.

tomas: can we support per-tenant SLA flags to opt-out of fallback? needed for regulated customers.

carmen: yes — tenant config exists; router needs to check policy before failing over. small perf hit but fine.

jen: logs: include structured line on failure, e.g.:
```
{"ts":1630000000, "event":"handshake_fail", "tenant":"acct-123", "agent":"agent-abc", "err":"cert_mismatch", "attempt":3, "backoff_ms":1200}
```

sara: good. also emit an 'invalidate' event when we flush token cache: `tenant.invalidate` with a reason code.

michael: testing: we need an e2e harness that replays onboarding churn at scale (10k parallel attaches) and validates backoff + fallback. can spike a dev cluster with synthetic agents.

jen: timeline idea: week 0: RFC follow-up with schema + ops runbook. week 1: implement agent backoff lib + CP side metrics. week 2: e2e harness + gradual rollout behind feature flag.

sara: I'll draft the RFC follow-up (telemetry schema + dashboards).

carmen: i'll own the invalidate event and operator playbook for rotations.

michael: i'll prototype fallback flow and the relay tagging in console.

tomas: assigning follow-ups: sara (telemetry schema), jen (backoff lib), michael (fallback flow), carmen (invalidate event + ops doc). i'll open a PR for handshake contract changes and include the log/metric names. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy check OK — no infra blockers for RFC branch.

sara: thanks — will aim to have RFC draft by EOD tomorrow.

tomas: great, once RFC is up we can schedule a short design review.
